organization.name: DRIMORIA SUPPORT ORGANISATION
organization.mission: To empower vulnerable girls and women, support orphans and provide care, protection and accommodation to street children through sustainable community initiatives.
organization.vision: To build a compassionate and empowered community where girls, women, orphans and street children live safe, dignified and productive lives.

objectives: Empower girls and women socially, economically and emotionally
Support orphans with education, healthcare and basic needs
Provide shelter, rehabilitation and care for street children
Advocate for the rights and protection of vulnerable people
Work with partners to improve social welfare in communities

programs.name: Women Empowerment
programs.description: Economic and social empowerment programs for girls and women including vocational training and business support.

programs.name: Education for Orphans
programs.description: Comprehensive educational support, scholarships, and mentoring for orphaned children to achieve their potential.

programs.name: Street Children Care
programs.description: Safe shelter, rehabilitation, healthcare, and reintegration support for street children and youth.

programs.name: Community Development
programs.description: Initiatives promoting self-reliance, community awareness, and sustainable development in local areas.

programs.name: Rights Advocacy
programs.description: Advocacy for protection of vulnerable people's rights and raising community awareness on social issues.

programs.name: Partnership & Welfare
programs.description: Collaborating with partners to improve social welfare systems and create positive community impact.
